journalPacks.title: Morning Kickstart
journalPacks.description: Set your intention before the day begins.

questions.question: What's 1 thing I'm grateful for?
What's 1 thing I'm excited about?
What's 1 virtue I want to exhibit today?
What's 1 thing I'm avoiding?
What's the 1 thing I need to do today?

journalPacks.title: Evening Shutdown
journalPacks.description: Close your day with clarity, release mental loops, and seed tomorrow.

questions.question: What were your biggest wins and completed deep work blocks today?
questions.hint: Celebrate effort and progress over perfection.

questions.question: Where did you get stuck or distracted, and what can you let go of before sleep?
questions.hint: Acknowledge friction with honest curiosity, then close the mental loop.

questions.question: What is the single most important action that must happen tomorrow?
questions.hint: This will directly seed your tomorrow plan.

journalPacks.title: Daily Reflection
journalPacks.description: Look back at your day with honest curiosity and feel-good energy.

questions.question: What was the absolute highlight of your day — the moment that brought genuine fulfillment?
questions.hint: Can be a breakthrough, a conversation, or a quiet win.

questions.question: Where did you bring a sense of play, curiosity, or lightness to your tasks today?
questions.hint: Play reduces resistance and builds sustained stamina.

questions.question: Where did you feel in control, confident, or capable today?
questions.hint: Notice moments where you exercised agency over distraction.

questions.question: What interaction energized you or made you feel connected to someone else?
What is one concrete keystone action to focus on tomorrow to keep momentum high?

journalPacks.title: The Eulogy Method
journalPacks.description: Live your life backwards — start from the end.

questions.question: Imagine you've lived to 100, healthy in body, mind, and spirit. You're observing your own funeral from above. What would you want people to say about how you lived?
Imagine you have unlimited time, money, and courage. What would you want to experience, achieve, create, or contribute?
What problems or challenges in the world would you seek to remedy?
Which of your unique abilities bring you the most joy when using them?
If you could leave one lasting positive change in the world, what would it be?
What would you do if money were no object? How would you use your talents to serve others?

journalPacks.title: Fear Setting (Tim Ferriss)
journalPacks.description: Define your fears instead of your goals.

questions.question: What is the worst thing that will happen if I do the thing I fear?
List 10-20 things that could go wrong — catastrophize fully.
What can I do to prevent each of those worst things from happening?
If the worst case happened, how could I repair it?
What are the benefits of an attempt or partial success?
If I don't do this, what will my life look like in 6 months, 1 year, and 3 years?

journalPacks.title: Odyssey Plans
journalPacks.description: Design three versions of your next 5 years.

questions.question: Plan 1: What would my life look like over the next 5 years if I follow the same path I'm on now?
Plan 2: What would my life look like if I couldn't do what I'm doing now and had to choose the next thing instead?
Plan 3: What would my life look like if money wasn't an issue and I could do whatever I wanted?
Which of these plans excites and energizes you the most? Why?
What is one step you can take today toward that plan?

journalPacks.title: 12 Month Celebration
journalPacks.description: Rate your life now, then imagine a 10/10 a year from today.

questions.question: Rate yourself 1-10: Physical Health. What would make it a 10 in a year?
Rate yourself 1-10: Mental Health. What would a 10 look like?
Rate yourself 1-10: Family relationships. Your 10 in a year?
Rate yourself 1-10: Friendships. What needs to change?
Rate yourself 1-10: Romantic relationship (or desired one). Your vision?
Rate yourself 1-10: Career. What does success look like?
Rate yourself 1-10: Finances. What number and why?
Rate yourself 1-10: Learning & growth. What's the goal?
Rate yourself 1-10: Experiences & joy. Your 10 in a year?
Now imagine you're celebrating with a friend in one year — describe that night. What made it worth celebrating?

journalPacks.title: 80/20 Life Audit
journalPacks.description: Find the 20% that drives 80% of your results — and pain.

questions.question: Where am I feeling satisfied in life right now? (Brain dump — health, finances, relationships, career, spirituality, everything.)
Where am I feeling dissatisfied? (Brain dump everything.)
Looking at your satisfaction list — which 20% are creating 80% of the positive results?
Looking at your dissatisfaction list — which 20% are causing 80% of the negative results?
What is one action you can take to amplify the positive 20% and reduce the negative 20%?

journalPacks.title: Bottleneck Analysis
journalPacks.description: Find the one thing holding everything back.

questions.question: What's the biggest bottleneck to achieving my next goal?
Why aren't I working on that bottleneck today?

journalPacks.title: The Compounding Projection
journalPacks.description: Where do your daily actions lead?

questions.question: If I repeated every action I took today, every day for a year, where would I end up?
Is that where I want to be? If not, what one action can I change tomorrow?

journalPacks.title: Morgan Housel's Questions
journalPacks.description: 10 uncomfortable questions that reveal how you think.

questions.question: Whose life do I admire that is secretly miserable?
What do I believe is true only because believing it puts me in good standing with my tribe?
What annoys me about other people that I sometimes do myself?
Which of my current values would be different if I were raised by different parents?
What do I believe the most with the least amount of evidence?
What do I think is a universal truth but is actually just a norm in my culture?
What has the right answer but I ignore because they're a bad communicator?
Who is full of it but I pay attention to because they're a good communicator?
What in my field is impossible to know no matter how smart I become?
What in my field do I think is a law but is actually just a rule?

journalPacks.title: 10 Favorite Prompts
journalPacks.description: Timeless questions to return to again and again.

questions.question: What would you do if money were no object? How would you use your talents to serve others?
What would you like people to say at your funeral?
If I repeat this week's actions for 10 years, where does it lead — and is that where I want to be?
What activities in the last 2 weeks have energized me vs. drained me?
How is my wheel of life? Rate: work, health, relationships.
Odyssey plan: current path (5 years), alternative path, radical path. What does each look like?
What is my goal — and what is the bottleneck holding it back?
Which goal, if achieved, would have the greatest impact on my life?
Do I work for my business/career, or does it work for me?
If I knew I was going to die 2 years from now, how would I spend my time?

journalPacks.title: 10 Year Dreamline
journalPacks.description: What do you want to learn, see, have, be, and do in the next decade?

questions.question: What do you want to LEARN in the next 10 years?
What do you want to SEE?
What do you want to HAVE?
Who do you want to BE?
What do you want to TRY?
What do you want to DO?
Where do you want to GO?
What do you want to CREATE?
What do you want to CONTRIBUTE to?
What do you want to OVERCOME?

journalPacks.title: When Bad Things Happen
journalPacks.description: Process difficult events with clarity and self-compassion.

questions.question: What happened, objectively? (Just the facts.)
What did I make it mean?
How would I comfort a friend I loved if this happened to them?
How could this be the best thing that has ever happened to me?

journalPacks.title: Self-Discovery
journalPacks.description: Understand your patterns, values, and hidden beliefs.

questions.question: What is a view about the world that has changed for you as you've gotten older?
What is a reminder that you would like to tell yourself next time you are in a downward spiral?
What are some things that frustrate you? Can you find any values that explain why they bug you so much?
What do you need to give yourself more credit for?
What is a positive habit you would really like to cultivate? Why and how could you get started?
What is holding you back from being more productive at the moment? What can you do about that?
How much do your current goals reflect your desires vs. someone else's?
What does 'ready' feel like to you? How did you know you were ready for a major step?
What is something that you have a hard time being honest about, even to those you trust the most? Why?
What made you feel most alive when you were young? How can you bring more of that into your life now?

journalPacks.title: Relationships & Connection
journalPacks.description: Explore the relationships that shape your life.

questions.question: How did you bond with one of the best friends you've ever had?
What did you learn from your last relationship? If you haven't had one, what could you learn from observing one?
Who is the most difficult person in your life and why?
Who is somebody that you miss? Why?
What are some small things that other people have done that really make your day?
What is a boundary that you need to draw in your life?
Write a letter to someone you miss dearly. (Sending is optional.)

journalPacks.title: Work & Purpose
journalPacks.description: Align your daily work with deeper meaning.

questions.question: What part of your work do you most enjoy? What part do you least enjoy? Why?
Do you work for your business/career, or does it work for you?
What is something that you could invest more money in to make life smoother and easier?
What would you do if you could stop time for two months?
What could you do to make your life more meaningful?
What biases do you need to work on?

journalPacks.title: Deep Discipline & Habit Arc
journalPacks.description: Diagnose friction, extract actionable insight, and recalibrate your execution with the 5-Node Arc.

questions.question: What was the single keystone habit or standard you set out to uphold?
questions.hint: Name the exact discipline or focus commitment.

questions.question: What actually happened when the friction showed up? (Facts without self-judgment)
questions.hint: Observe the breakdown like an impartial scientist.

questions.question: What was the true trigger of breakdown — environment, energy, emotional avoidance, or friction threshold?
questions.hint: Look for the hidden cause behind the impulse.

questions.question: What did this breakdown reveal about your current system or invisible rules?
questions.hint: Every relapse carries the blueprint of your next system tweak.

questions.question: What is one immediate, micro-adjustment you will commit to tomorrow?
questions.hint: Make the right thing easier or the wrong thing harder.

journalPacks.title: Shadow Self & Emotions
journalPacks.description: Face the parts of yourself you usually avoid.

questions.question: What emotion do you avoid feeling the most? Where does it live in your body?
What happens when you get angry? What is the anger really trying to protect?
Which emotions in others do you have a difficult time being around? Why?
What is a made-up rule about your life that you are applying to yourself? How has it held you back?
When was the last time you had to hold your tongue? What would you have said?
What is a question you are really scared to know the answer to?
Write about a mistake that taught you something about yourself.
Write an apology to yourself for a time you treated yourself poorly.

journalPacks.title: Creativity & Play
journalPacks.description: Reconnect with your imagination and sense of wonder.

questions.question: Draw 25 circles (5x5 grid). Set a 3-minute timer and turn each into something unique.
Draw a small scribble on the page, then use your imagination to turn it into a full drawing.
Write a complete story in exactly six words.
What made you feel most alive when you were young? How would that version of you spend today?
If you could stop time for two months, what would you create or explore?
What is a positive habit you would really like to cultivate? Describe the most playful way to start.

journalPacks.title: Mindset & Beliefs
journalPacks.description: Examine the invisible beliefs running your life.

questions.question: What is a view about the world that has changed for you as you've gotten older?
Are you taking enough risks in your life? Would you like to change your relationship to risk?
What biases do you need to work on?
What is something that you grew out of that meant a lot to you at the time?
Which quotes or pieces of advice do you have committed to memory? Why have those stuck?
What life lessons, advice, or habits have you picked up from fiction books?
Think about a 'what if?' scenario — work through the problem and identify your options.
What's a belief you held 5 years ago that you now completely disagree with? What changed you?

journalPacks.title: The Complete 100 (Remaining)
journalPacks.description: The rest of the 100 prompts collection — all in one pack.

questions.question: What sensations or experiences do you tend to avoid in your life? Why?
What was a seemingly inconsequential decision that made a big impact in your life?
Which songs have vivid memories for you?
Why do you dress the way that you do?
Who has been your greatest teacher?
Write a thank you note to someone. (Sending is optional.)
Write about an aspect of your personality that you appreciate in other people as well.
Write about something (or someone) that is currently tempting you.
You have been temporarily blinded by a bright light. When your vision clears, what do you see?
Take a task you've been dreading and break it into the smallest possible steps.
How do the opinions of others affect you?
How do you feel about asking for help?
In what ways are you currently self-sabotaging or holding yourself back?
What pet peeves do you have? Any idea why they drive you so crazy?
What is something that you would like to let go of?
